name: Rick Scott
role: U.S. Senator from Florida (2019–present); Governor of Florida (2011–2019)
summary: Republican senator and former governor whose published plan combines tax cuts, a balanced budget, term limits, school choice and a market economy with strict border control, voter ID, opposition to abortion and gender-transition for minors, colour-blind law and an America-first foreign policy that still backs allies, especially Israel. He treats socialism as the main domestic threat and wants most federal programmes shrunk or moved to states.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Voted Yes on the NDAA bills 2019-2023.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Plan point 3: fund the police and stop all efforts to defund them.

abortion-legal.rationale: Voted No on the Women's Health Protection Act (Feb and May 2022) and Yes on bills barring taxpayer-funded abortion.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Plan: 'immigration without assimilation makes us weaker'; melting pot, oppose cultural segregation.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Voted No on the 2021 and 2022 budget resolutions and reconciliation bill and on debt-limit increases.

basic-income.rationale: Plan: no government assistance unless disabled or aggressively seeking work.

central-planning.rationale: Plan: get rid of the 'old, slow, closed, top-down, government-run-everything system'; socialism always leads to poverty.

close-ties-china.rationale: Plan: gradually end all imports from Communist China until it honours human rights; 'treat our enemies like enemies'.

collective-defense.rationale: Plan: always defend our allies; hearing: allies must carry their share of defence first.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Plan point 2: no government policy based on race; equal opportunity but not equal outcomes.

decide-locally.rationale: Plan: eliminate federal programs that can be done locally; any government function that can be handled locally should be.

defeat-communism.rationale: Plan: socialism treated as a foreign combatant; wind down imports from Communist China.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Voted No on the 2022 climate and tax reconciliation bill and on a Civilian Climate Corps amendment.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Plan: no UN dues to bodies that undermine US interests; no aid to countries that oppose the US at the UN.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Plan: 'We will always defend our allies, starting with Israel'; hearing: allies must build their own militaries first.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Plan point 2: colleges that favour students by race lose federal funding and tax-exempt status; hiring on qualifications, not quotas.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Plan: all made in the image of God, judged by character not skin colour; no citizen denied the vote by race.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Plan: America strives for equal opportunity but will not guarantee equal outcomes.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Plan: 'We are a stronger nation because we are a nation of immigrants'.

ethnicity-statistics.rationale: Plan: government will never again ask citizens to disclose race, ethnicity or skin colour on any form.

exclude-trans-women-women-only-spaces.rationale: Plan: ban biological males from women's sports; other women-only spaces are not addressed.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Voted Yes on amendments requiring onshore and offshore oil and gas lease sales (Aug 2022).

expand-nuclear.rationale: Voted Yes on a 2023 amendment creating a Nuclear Fuel Security Program.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: Plan promises no tax increases of any kind and a supermajority to raise any tax or fee.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Plan: balance the budget and prohibit debt-ceiling increases absent a declaration of war.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Plan point 7: non-citizen voting (as in New York City) is 'too insane for words' and must be stopped.

free-trade.rationale: Plan: no trade that costs American workers jobs, terminate any trade deal that does, wind down imports from China.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Plan point 9: two genders, no government forms asking about gender identity.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Plan point 2: government hires on qualifications, 'not quotas of any kind'.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Plan point 9: there are two genders, humans are born male and female; to deny that is to deny science.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Plan point 1: kids learn about the Constitution, Bill of Rights, founders and that America is a great country.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Voted Yes on the Senate resolution standing with Israel (Oct 2023) and on Israel security bills; a vote only, not a statement on statehood, so low.

limit-growth.rationale: Plan: grow America's economy and adopt no 'nutty' climate policies that harm the economy or jobs.

limit-guns.rationale: Record points both ways: as governor he signed the 2018 law raising the rifle age to 21, a waiting period and risk protection orders; in the Senate he voted against the 2022 Safer Communities Act.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Plan: mandatory strict minimum sentences for assaults causing serious injury to officers.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Plan: government should do nothing the private sector can do better and cheaper (the 'Do It Better' test), with work going to business.

military-superiority.rationale: Voted Yes on the NDAA bills 2019-2023.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Plan: the 'Do It Better' test sends work to business; veterans may choose VA or private care; faith-based providers used.

more-religion-public.rationale: Plan point 10: Americans free to welcome God into all aspects of life and live out convictions in the public square.

nation-first.rationale: Plan point 11: 'We are Americans, not globalists'; dependent on no other country.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Floor speech: capitalism is what the country believes in; socialism is 'a failed ideology'; plan calls socialism un-American.

open-borders.rationale: Plan point 4: 'Nations have borders'; no one enters without permission and no one has a 'right' to come.

patriotic-education.rationale: Plan point 1: pledge of allegiance, anthem, flag, teach children America is exceptional.

pay-off-national-debt.rationale: Plan: 'begin paying down debt' with asset sales; not a pledge to repay fully.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Plan promises no tax increases of any kind; he spoke against a carbon tax (Oct 2021).

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Plan: 'Americans, not globalists'; floor speech criticises the EU's trade surplus and defence spending.

prohibit-child-medical-transition.rationale: Plan point 9: no doctor may perform irreversible gender-altering procedures on a minor.

property-sabotage-justified.rationale: Plan: zero tolerance for protests that attack police, loot businesses and burn cities.

public-ownership.rationale: Plan: sell government assets and buildings, end 'government-run-everything', and treat socialism as a foreign combatant.

racial-franchise.rationale: Plan: no citizen may be given special voting privileges based on race, religion or ethnic origin.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Plan: stop dividing people by race, skin colour or ethnicity; judge by character.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Voted No on the March 2021 vote to raise the federal minimum wage (HR 1319); a vote only.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Plan point 4: secure the border, no one has a 'right' to come, oppose comprehensive reform until the border is secure; but 'a nation of immigrants'.

rehabilitation.rationale: Plan: end 'soft-on-crime' days, stiffer penalties for theft and violent crime, mandatory minimums for assaults on officers; rehabilitation is not mentioned.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Plan point 10: Americans will not be required to act against core beliefs; faith groups not forced to hire against their tenets.

reserved-seats-excluded-groups.rationale: Plan: no special voting privileges based on race, religion or ethnic origin; no government policy based on race.

restrict-private-adult-pornography-acces.rationale: Plan: enforce existing federal obscenity laws; hold platforms accountable for shielding children from pornography.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Plan: no foreign aid to countries that oppose the US at the UN; only help countries willing to defend themselves.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Voted No on passage of the Respect for Marriage Act (Nov 2022), which repealed DOMA; a vote only, so medium.

school-vouchers.rationale: Plan point 1: parents, not government, choose schools; school choice so no child is sent to a failing school by zip code.

separate-church-state.rationale: Plan point 10 aims to stop efforts to 'drive all mention of God out of public view' and for religion in the public square, not strict separation.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Plan point 9: humans are born male and female.

slavery-reparations.rationale: Plan: no government policy can be based on race or ethnicity.

social-market-economy.rationale: Floor speech: 'We want safety nets' (Medicaid, food stamps 'not socialism'), alongside defence of capitalism.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Plan point 10: stop government efforts to drive God out of public view; voluntary prayer protected.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Plan and hearing stress defending allies and a share-the-burden alliance with NATO partners.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Voted for a 2020 amendment limiting FISA surveillance of US persons and against the 2024 FISA bill.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Voted Yes on an amendment imposing added duties on Chinese imports (June 2023); a vote only, so medium.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Plan promises no tax increases of any kind and a supermajority to raise any tax or fee.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Plan: no tax increases 'at all' and a two-thirds supermajority to raise any tax or fee.

term-limits.rationale: Plan point 6: 12-year limits for Congress and bureaucrats.

trade-surplus.rationale: Floor speech: fix the trade deficit with the EU through more purchases of American goods.

traditional-family.rationale: Plan point 8: the nuclear family is crucial to civilization and 'God's design'; must be protected and celebrated.

turn-back-illegal-migrants.rationale: Voted Yes on a June 2023 amendment to secure the borders; a vote only and not specific to turn-backs, so low.

voter-id.rationale: Plan point 7: voter ID must be the law; all arguments against it are in favour of fraud.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Plan: immigrants not eligible for welfare or unemployment for 7 years; stop incentivising people to come for benefits.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Plan: no assistance unless disabled or seeking work; able-bodied under 60 without young children should work.

notes: Themes searched: economy and taxes, welfare, health care, abortion and family, race, immigration, crime and guns, elections, government reform, energy and climate, trade and China, NATO, Ukraine, Israel, military, religion, technology. Answers come from his published 12-point plan, floor speeches and hearing remarks, Senate roll calls and one law he signed as governor. Many specific statements (government structure, ideology, theory-heavy ones) have no recorded position and stay null. His Florida governor-era acts beyond SB 7026 were not cited.
